title: EWA-DB – Early Warning of Alzheimer speech database
why_promising: Large primary clinical production resource: 1,649 speakers across sustained-vowel phonation, diadochokinesis, naming and picture-description tasks; public WAV for 1,003 consented speakers and JSON metadata/transcriptions; Zenodo reports manual annotation available for 965 speakers.
open_question: Enumerate the Zenodo file tree and determine exactly what the manual annotation covers (orthographic transcript vs temporal/phonetic labels), whether it is separable from ASR output, and which consented recordings link to human annotation. Admit only qualifying human-created/corrected production layers; preserve ASR separately as excluded provenance.
